## Checklist

- [ ] The PR is linked to an issue ("Closes #n") and added to the product's project board
- [ ] Tests pass locally and new behaviour is covered by tests where practical
- [ ] README / docs updated if behaviour, setup or deployment changed
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Accessibility checked for UI changes (labels, contrast, Dynamic Type / text scaling)
